items.t: B. Riley Securities Maintains Buy on FuboTV, Lowers Price Target to $16
items.sum: B. Riley Securities analyst Drew Crum maintains FuboTV (NYSE:FUBO) with a Buy and lowers the price target from $18 to $16.
